name: Nocatee, Ponte Vedra
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Nocatee, Ponte Vedra?
answer_short: Yes, electric golf carts. St. Johns and Duval county ordinances let them use Nocatee roads posted 25 mph or less, signed golf cart paths and designated multi-use trails. Street-legal LSVs may use roads posted 35 mph or less. Nocatee Parkway, CR 210, US 1 and Valley Ridge Blvd are off limits.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart on Valley Ridge Blvd in Nocatee, Ponte Vedra?
faq.a: No. Valley Ridge Blvd is posted 45 mph, so golf carts aren't allowed in the street. Use the greenway trails where they connect.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart at night in Nocatee, Ponte Vedra?
faq.a: Only if it has headlights, brake lights, turn signals and a windshield, under the Nocatee golf cart rules.
